text.en: Usable with care: only the factory confirms this vault's address and no Hyperithm page lists it. Read To review first and send a small amount first.
text.zh-TW: 可以用，但要小心：只有工廠確認這個 vault 的地址，Hyperithm 也沒有頁面列出它。先看待確認，第一次先送小額。

text.en: Pulls the amount you type of USDC from the Safe with `transferFrom` (read in the source)
text.zh-TW: 用 `transferFrom` 從 Safe 拉走你填的金額的 USDC（讀原始碼）

text.en: Deposits the pulled USDC into this vault with `deposit`, which mints the shares to the Safe
text.zh-TW: 用 `deposit` 把拉來的 USDC 存進這個 vault，vault 把份額鑄給 Safe

pastTxsConclusion.en: No Safe has used the template's route on this vault: every Safe that deposited went through Bundler3, refused now. The one use of the new route is an EOA with a USDC `permit` in place of an approval.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 沒有 Safe 在這個 vault 走過模板的路線：存款的 Safe 都走 Bundler3，現在不接受。走新路線的只有一個 EOA，用 USDC 的 `permit` 取代授權。

text.en: In the sample, 0 Safes and 1 EOA used the new route on this vault, so no past transaction shows it working for a Safe here. The evidence rests on the template's test transactions, Safe deposits into another Morpho V2 vault through the same VaultBundlesV1. Both vaults answered `isVaultV2` from the same factory.
text.zh-TW: 樣本裡這個 vault 走新路線的 Safe 是 0 個、EOA 是 1 個，沒有任何 Safe 在這裡做成過。證據靠模板的測試交易：Safe 經同一個 VaultBundlesV1 存進另一個 Morpho V2 vault；兩個 vault 都由同一個工廠確認。

recommendation.en: Send a small amount first and check that the shares reach the Safe before you send the rest.
recommendation.zh-TW: 先送小額，確認份額真的進了 Safe，再送剩下的。

text.en: This vault's size moved sharply over the year: it rose from almost nothing to its peak within two months, then more than halved and doubled again several times. A few holders own most of the shares. The program's figures are in the Instance section.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 的規模一年內變動很大：兩個月內從幾乎是零升到最高點，之後又幾度減半再翻倍。大部分份額集中在少數幾個持有人手上。程式量到的數字在「實例」區。

recommendation.en: Deposit only an amount you can accept being unable to withdraw for a while, since a large holder leaving can use up what can be withdrawn. Send a small amount first.
recommendation.zh-TW: 只存你能接受暫時提不出的金額，因為大戶離開可能把能提的錢用完。先送小額。

text.en: Your USDC stays idle in the vault after you deposit: no liquidity adapter is set (`liquidityAdapter()` is the zero address at block 26,490,392), so nothing moves it on in the same transaction. An allocator lends it out later with `allocate`.
text.zh-TW: 存進去後 USDC 先閒置在 vault：目前沒設流動性 adapter（區塊 26,490,392 的 `liquidityAdapter()` 是零地址），同一筆交易不會再轉走，之後由 allocator 用 `allocate` 借出去。

text.en: Allocators lend it to Morpho Blue USDC markets through the vault's one adapter, within caps the curator sets. Morpho's API on 2026-11-25 shows most of it with PT-reUSD-10DEC2026, mHyperBTC and PT-USDat-14JAN2027 as collateral; this changes whenever an allocator reallocates.
text.zh-TW: allocator 透過 vault 唯一的 adapter，把 USDC 借給 Morpho Blue 的 USDC 市場，金額受策展人設的上限限制。Morpho 的 API（2026-11-25）顯示大部分在以 PT-reUSD-10DEC2026、mHyperBTC 和 PT-USDat-14JAN2027 為抵押品的市場；allocator 重新分配就會變。

text.en: Two allocators can move funds between markets at any time, within the caps. The curator must wait 3 days to add an adapter or raise a cap, but can add an allocator, change the fees or set the withdrawal penalty at once.
text.zh-TW: 兩個 allocator 隨時可以在上限內把資金搬到別的市場。策展人加 adapter 或調高上限要等 3 天，但新增 allocator、改手續費、設提款罰金可以立刻做。

title.zh-TW: 怎麼把 USDC 拿回來

text.en: About 300,001 of the vault's 7.21 million USDC sits idle (block 26,490,392). A larger withdrawal fails until an allocator moves USDC back, or someone calls `forceDeallocate`, which charges a penalty (0 now; the curator can raise it to 2% at once). A market can return only what its borrowers have not borrowed.
text.zh-TW: vault 的 721 萬 USDC 裡閒置約 300,001（區塊 26,490,392）。比這多的提款會失敗，直到 allocator 把 USDC 撤回，或有人呼叫 `forceDeallocate` 並付罰金（目前是 0，策展人可以立刻調高到 2%）。市場也只能還出沒被借走的 USDC。

text.en: The program's only place is the factory: VaultV2Factory answers `isVaultV2` = true. Etherscan shows the contract VaultV2 at 0x093272C07700d3cA5301C3Bf9B3A392624179E2F, made by the factory 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405. AI found no Hyperithm or Morpho page that lists it without the address in the URL.
text.zh-TW: 程式唯一的確認來源是工廠：VaultV2Factory 回答 `isVaultV2` = true。Etherscan 顯示 0x093272C07700d3cA5301C3Bf9B3A392624179E2F 是 VaultV2 合約，由工廠 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405 建立。AI 沒找到 Hyperithm 或 Morpho 不靠網址帶地址就列出它的頁面。

recommendation.en: Open the vault from the Morpho app's vault list yourself and compare the full address. Send a small amount the first time.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己從 Morpho app 的 vault 列表點進這個 vault，比對完整地址。第一次送小額。

role.en: USDC vault (V2) named Hyperithm USDC Apex
role.zh-TW: 名為 Hyperithm USDC Apex 的 USDC vault（V2）

text.en: Morpho's API (api.morpho.org/graphql), `vaultV2s` filtered by the curator 0x75178137D3B4B9A0F771E0e149b00fB8167BA325 on chain 1, answers this address as Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa), listed. A search, so it does not count
text.zh-TW: Morpho 的 API（api.morpho.org/graphql）以策展人 0x75178137D3B4B9A0F771E0e149b00fB8167BA325 篩選鏈 1 的 `vaultV2s`，回答這個地址是 Hyperithm USDC Apex（hyperUSDCa），已上架。這是搜尋，不算一個來源

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract VaultV2, created through the factory 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405 at block 23,666,454
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約 VaultV2，在區塊 23,666,454 經由工廠 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405 建立

text.en: Hyperithm's own site lists no Morpho vault and no vault address
text.zh-TW: Hyperithm 自己的網站沒有列出任何 Morpho vault 或 vault 地址
